properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured), the FOURTH instance of the parks-not-reached class: a requirement only a person can meet ("Anthony provisions hardware") raised unsatisfied_requirement. It cleared only through `governed_by ruling=parks`, which the designer had to already know. The gap reads parking (detect.rs:2430) but its text offers only "covered, deferred, or dropped?". The parking sentence was added to orphan_node's repair text alone, which even says the unsatisfied-requirement gap reads parking, and no gap-walking skill names it
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, item I12 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (friction #11, 0.74.0): "A requirement meant for a human act raised `unsatisfied_requirement` and `unthreaded_cluster` (Anthony provisions hardware). Workaround: governed_by ruling=parks on the accepted delegation decision. That cleared the gap but needed knowing the `parks` mechanism." NOT affected: the mechanism. Parking worked the first time it was used.

② PRECEDENT, searched verbatim in both designs:
- dec:idea-parks-shipped-and-was-still-not-reached-the-instruction-is-missing-where-the-person-is-stuck (2026-08-19, the third instance): "`parks` is documented ON THE TOOL... A person in this situation is not reading tool hints; they are reading the messages that told them they had a problem". Its fix list, item 1, targeted orphan_node's text.
- cap:a-finding-names-the-mechanism-that-parks-a-deliberate-state (realized) did exactly that, for orphan_node.

③ CANDIDATES:
- (a) the gap does not read parking;
- (b) it reads parking and its words do not say so;
- (c) the skills that walk gaps do not teach it;
- (d) the need is not "parked" at all but "met by a person outside the design", which nothing models.

④⑤ MEASURED at 0.74.0:
- detect.rs:2430 calls `is_parked` before counting satisfiers, so (a) is refuted.
- detect.rs:2486-2490, the non-deferred title and description: "Nothing satisfies requirement “{name}”" / "has no capability delivering it — is it covered, deferred, or dropped?" No word of parking, so (b) holds.
- grep over every SKILL.md in the checkout: only link-artifacts and why mention parks; detect-and-ask, genesis and check-health do not, so (c) holds.
- heal.rs's orphan_node repair text names parks and says the unsatisfied-requirement gap reads it. The one place that says so is a different finding.

⑥ CLASS: an instruction fixed at the reader who reported it, while every other place the same person gets stuck was never asked. This is the fourth measured instance: dev_storyflow on 2026-08-04 and 08-15, reflow2 on 08-19, and this one. The fix at the class is to name the mechanism on every finding and gap whose rule reads it, pinned by a test that walks the rules reading `is_parked` and asserts their text names it. Fixing this one string would stop only today's report.

⑦⑧ OWED: that test, failing today, then the words, and the detect-and-ask skill's line.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether parking is even the right model here (candidate d). "Parks" asserts the unsatisfied state is correct. A requirement a PERSON will meet is not correctly unsatisfied; it is allocated to someone outside the design. That modelling question is recorded with the outside-party idea, dec:idea-an-outside-part-is-marked-as-outside-and-an-outside-party-is-a-consumer, not decided here.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed at the class by reflow2 PR #625 (squash 42259ba). heal.rs's PARKING_READERS and one shared parks sentence reach every finding that reads parking. every_finding_that_reads_parking_names_it.rs enumerates the source's parking reads. Its change record, chg:a-finding-or-refusal-names-the-route-that-works, is in the committed design, not this live store. The modelling question in ⑨ (candidate d) remains with the idea it names.
